methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing collected from each vendor's official pricing page or authoritative third-party listing, accessed 2026-06-15. Telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null on all plans — non-telephony vertical. monthlyUsd reflects effective monthly cost at the smallest self-serve tier: annualized where only annual billing is published, month-to-month where available. Friendly Captcha publishes prices only in EUR on their website (friendlycaptcha.com); no vendor-confirmed USD price exists, so all its paid tiers carry monthlyUsd=null with a note (a GetApp listing's '$9'/'$39' are par symbol-swaps of the EUR figures, not real conversions, and are not treated as confirmed). GeeTest and Arkose Labs have no published self-serve pricing — all tiers are contact-sales/custom; monthlyUsd=null throughout. Cloudflare Turnstile Free tier is genuinely $0 with no rate limits on verifications; Enterprise requires contacting sales. reCAPTCHA Enterprise Premium tier: 0–10,000 assessments/month free, 10,001–100,000 assessments = $8 flat fee, above 100,000 = $0.001/assessment ($1 per 1,000); effective monthlyUsd=$8 reflects the smallest paid commitment. annualDiscountPct=null for reCAPTCHA as pricing is pay-as-you-go with no published annual discount.
